pictures.scene: Leonardo da Vinci, The Last Supper — Christ seated at the centre of a long table in a red and blue robe with the twelve apostles gathered in groups on either side of Him and three bright windows opening behind, and calling his twelve disciples to him, jesus gave them authority over unclean spirits, so that they could drive them out and heal every disease and sickness, these are the names of the twelve apostles, first simon, called peter, and his brother andrew, james son of zebedee, and his brother john

pictures.scene: Giotto, The Kiss of Judas — Judas in a yellow cloak folding his arm around the haloed Christ and leaning in to kiss Him while soldiers press around them with clubs and torches raised against a deep blue sky, philip and bartholomew, thomas and matthew the tax collector, james son of alphaeus, and thaddaeus, simon the zealot, and judas iscariot, who betrayed jesus
pictures.name: pd_giotto_the_kiss_of_judas

pictures.scene: Jean-Francois Millet, The Sheepfold by Moonlight — a flock of sheep penned close behind a long hurdle fence on an open plain with a low moon hanging in the wide night sky above them, these twelve jesus sent out with the following instructions, do not go onto the road of the gentiles or enter any town of the samaritans, go rather to the lost sheep of israel
pictures.name: pd_millet_the_sheepfold_moonlight

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Sermon of Saint John the Baptist — a preacher in brown standing at the centre of a dense crowd in a wood with listeners seated on the ground around him and others climbed up into the trees to hear, as you go, preach this message, the kingdom of heaven is near, heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, drive out demons, freely you have received, freely give

pictures.scene: Pieter de Hooch, The Courtyard of a House in Delft — a woman and a child stepping out under a worn brick archway set with a carved stone tablet while a second woman stands in the passage beyond, the paving swept clean and a pail and broom left by the wall, whatever town or village you enter, find out who is worthy there and stay at his house until you move on, as you enter the home, greet its occupants

pictures.scene: Meindert Hobbema, The Avenue at Middelharnis — a rutted sandy road running straight away between two rows of tall bare-trunked trees towards a village with a church tower, a man and his dog walking down the middle of it, if the home is worthy, let your peace rest on it, but if it is not, let your peace return to you, and if anyone will not welcome you or heed your words, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that home or town
pictures.name: pd_hobbema_the_avenue_at_middelharnis

pictures.scene: John Martin, The Destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah — a vast sheet of fire pouring down out of a red sky over a shattered city of dark walls and toppling towers while one small white-robed figure hurries away along the ridge in the foreground, truly i tell you, it will be more bearable for sodom and gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town, behold, i am sending you out like sheep among wolves, therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves
pictures.name: pd_martin_the_destruction_of_sodom_and_gomorrah

pictures.scene: Gerrit van Honthorst, Christ before the High Priest — Christ standing with His hands clasped in a pale robe on one side of a dark table lit by a single candle while the seated high priest raises a finger at Him across an open book, guards watching from the shadows behind, but beware of men, for they will hand you over to their councils and flog you in their synagogues, on my account, you will be brought before governors and kings as witnesses to them and to the gentiles
pictures.name: pd_honthorst_christ_before_the_high_priest

pictures.scene: El Greco, The Pentecost — the Virgin and the apostles pressed together under a dark vault with small tongues of flame standing above their heads and a white dove descending in a burst of gold light, but when they hand you over, do not worry about how to respond or what to say, in that hour you will be given what to say, for it will not be you speaking, but the spirit of your father speaking through you
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_pentecost

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Saint Paul in Prison — an old white-bearded man sitting on a low bed in a bare stone cell with an open book across his knees and a quill in his hand, stopped in thought with his hand at his mouth while light falls on the wall behind him, brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child, children will rise against their parents and have them put to death, you will be hated by everyone because of my name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved

pictures.scene: Adam Elsheimer, The Flight into Egypt — Joseph carrying a torch and leading the donkey that bears Mary and the child along the edge of a dark wood at night, with the full moon laid out on the still water beside them and the stars thick across the whole sky, when they persecute you in one town, flee to the next, truly i tell you, you will not reach all the towns of israel before the son of man comes, a disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master

pictures.scene: Gerrit Dou, The Night School — a schoolmaster leaning over a table to point out a line by candlelight while the children around him read and write, one girl shading a second candle with her hand and an hourglass standing on the board between them, it is enough for a disciple to be like his teacher, and a servant like his master, if the head of the house has been called beelzebul, how much more the members of his household, so do not be afraid of them, for there is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known

pictures.scene: El Greco, View of Toledo — a city of pale roofs and one tall spire standing along the crest of a green hill above a bridge and a river, under a black and silver storm sky that fills the upper half of the picture, what i tell you in the dark, speak in the daylight, what is whispered in your ear, proclaim from the housetops, do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul, instead, fear the one who can destroy both soul and body in hell
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_view_of_toledo

pictures.scene: Carel Fabritius, The Goldfinch — one small bird perched on the ring above its blue feeder box against a bare pale wall, a fine chain running from its leg down to the perch, are not two sparrows sold for a penny, yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your father, and even the very hairs of your head are all numbered
pictures.name: pd_fabritius_vogel

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Saint Peter Preaching — the haloed Peter standing barefoot in a blue and gold robe with one hand lifted in speech before a close crowd of men and women who turn their faces up to him, a green hillside rising behind them, so do not be afraid, you are worth more than many sparrows, therefore everyone who confesses me before men, i will also confess him before my father in heaven
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_saint_peter_preaching

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Denial of Saint Peter — a servant girl shielding a candle with her hand as she turns its light onto Peter, who stands in a pale cloak with his hands lifted in answer, while soldiers in dark burnished armour crowd the foreground, but whoever denies me before men, i will also deny him before my father in heaven, do not assume that i have come to bring peace to the earth, i have not come to bring peace, but a sword
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_the_denial_of_saint_peter

pictures.scene: Jan Steen, The Wrath of Ahasuerus — the crowned king risen from his place at the banquet with his arm flung out and his face dark with anger, the queen leaning away from him in red at the table's end, a dish upset and a blue and white jug smashed across the floor, for i have come to turn a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law, a man's enemies will be the members of his own household
pictures.name: pd_steen_the_wrath_of_ahasuerus

pictures.scene: El Greco, Christ Carrying the Cross — Christ in a blue cloak and red robe holding the beam of the cross against His shoulder with both hands, the crown of thorns pressed on His head and His eyes lifted upward into a stormy blue sky, anyone who loves his father or mother more than me is not worthy of me, anyone who loves his son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me, and anyone who does not take up his cross and follow me is not worthy of me
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_christ_carrying_the_cross

pictures.scene: Dieric Bouts, Christ in the House of Simon — Christ seated at a laid table with His hand raised in blessing while a woman kneels low on the tiled floor and dries His feet with her long hair, the host in a jewelled cap watching from beside Him, whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for my sake will find it, he who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives the one who sent me
pictures.name: pd_bouts_christ_in_the_house_of_simon

pictures.scene: Diego Velazquez, The Waterseller of Seville — a weathered man in a worn brown cloak handing a clear glass of water across the top of a great earthenware jar to a boy who takes it with both hands, a third man drinking in the shadows behind them, whoever receives a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet's reward, and whoever receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man will receive a righteous man's reward, and if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is my disciple, truly i tell you, he will never lose his reward
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_waterseller

lines.text: And calling His twelve disciples to Him, Jesus gave them authority over unclean spirits, so that they could drive them out and heal every disease and sickness.
These are the names of the twelve apostles: first Simon, called Peter, and his brother Andrew; James son of Zebedee, and his brother John;
Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;
Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus.
These twelve Jesus sent out with the following instructions: Do not go onto the road of the Gentiles or enter any town of the Samaritans.
Go rather to the lost sheep of Israel.
As you go, preach this message: The kingdom of heaven is near.
Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, drive out demons. Freely you have received; freely give.
Do not carry any gold or silver or copper in your belts.
Take no bag for the road, or second tunic, or sandals, or staff; for the worker is worthy of his provisions.
Whatever town or village you enter, find out who is worthy there and stay at his house until you move on.
As you enter the home, greet its occupants.
If the home is worthy, let your peace rest on it; but if it is not, let your peace return to you.
And if anyone will not welcome you or heed your words, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that home or town.
Truly I tell you, it will be more bearable for Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town.
Behold, I am sending you out like sheep among wolves; therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.
But beware of men; for they will hand you over to their councils and flog you in their synagogues.
On My account, you will be brought before governors and kings as witnesses to them and to the Gentiles.
But when they hand you over, do not worry about how to respond or what to say. In that hour you will be given what to say.
For it will not be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.
Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
When they persecute you in one town, flee to the next. Truly I tell you, you will not reach all the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes.
A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master.
It is enough for a disciple to be like his teacher, and a servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household!
So do not be afraid of them. For there is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.
What I tell you in the dark, speak in the daylight; what is whispered in your ear, proclaim from the housetops.
Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Instead, fear the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell.
Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.
And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
Therefore everyone who confesses Me before men, I will also confess him before My Father in heaven.
But whoever denies Me before men, I will also deny him before My Father in heaven.
Do not assume that I have come to bring peace to the earth; I have not come to bring peace, but a sword.
For I have come to turn a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
A man's enemies will be the members of his own household.
Anyone who loves his father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me; anyone who loves his son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me;
and anyone who does not take up his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me.
Whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
He who receives you receives Me, and he who receives Me receives the One who sent Me.
Whoever receives a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet's reward, and whoever receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man will receive a righteous man's reward.
And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is My disciple, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.
